messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 10 of Act 33/2019, amending pt1A (ARBITRATION COUNCIL OF INDIA; Definitions.; Establishment and incorporation of Arbitration Council of India.; Composition of Council.; Duties and functions of Council.; Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings of Council.; Resignation of Members.; Removal of Member.; Appointment of experts and constitution of Committees thereof.; General norms for grading of arbitral institutions.; Norms for accreditation.; Depository of awards.; Power to make regulations by Council.; Chief Executive Officer.)
Instruction (start): After Part I of the principal Act, the following Part shall be inserted, namely:— ‘PART IA ARBITRATION COUNCIL OF INDIA [[margin: Definitions.]] 43A. In this Part, unless the context otherwise requires,— (a) “Chairperson” means the Chairperson of the Arbitration Council of India appointed under clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 43C; (b) “Council” means the Arbitration Council of India estab

Source: Statement of Objects and Reasons, The Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2019 (as introduced in Rajya Sabha) (Government)
Quote: With a view to
strengthen institutional arbitration in the country, the said Committee, inter alia, recommended
for the establishment of an independent body for grading of arbitral institutions and
accreditation of arbitrators, etc.

Claim: The amendment was made to strengthen institutional arbitration in India by establishing an independent body for grading arbitral institutions and accrediting arbitrators.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"The source states the purpose of strengthening institutional arbitration by creating an independent grading and accreditation body, matching the claim."}
